test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 11 July 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Train P crosses train Q completely in 45 seconds, while running in opposite directions. The lengths of train P and train Q are 1200 metres and 1500 metres, respectively. The speed of train Q is 144 km/h. In how much time can train P cross an 1800-metre long platform?
solution:
**Given:**

The speed of train Q is 144 km/h.

**Concept used:**

Time = Distance/Speed

Relative speed = S1 + S2;

When both trains are crossing each other in the opposite direction

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of train P be a m/sec

Speed of Q in m/sec = 144 × (5/18)
